messages:
Maria: Pushing for a quick reserve of 8xA100 GPUs in staging for the feature burst tomorrow morning. Need to hold seats for the rollout window 08:00-12:00 PST. Can we get a soft hold before we submit formal quota?
Sam: We should open a tentative quota request with cloud first. Do we need GPUs in a single zone? or spread across zones for reliability?
Maria: Single zone preferred (us-west3-a) to keep network locality for the test harness. If single zone not possible, will accept two zones under same region.
Leo: Tagging procurement: @CloudProcurement — can you do a 24hr soft hold and tell us expected time to convert to a hard reservation?
CloudProcurement: CloudProcurement: We can request an "interest hold" with the provider but it's non-binding. For a guaranteed reservation we need a purchase order or reserved instance signoff. ETA for hold response: ~3-6 hours.
Ops-Bot: Ops-Bot: Reminder: submit quota request via internal form: /forms/gpu-quota -> attach region, counts, window, justification.
Nina: I'll draft the justification — short. Maria, can you confirm runner counts and expected p95 utilization?
Maria: Sure — 8 GPUs, each will run 2 parallel workers, expected p95 token throughput ~1.8k/sec per GPU. Peak memory 40GB. Duration ~4h. Justification: staging soak for new runtime + perf regression check.
Devon: We should include fallback model plan in case quota isn't approved. Suggest plan: fall back to 4xA100 + micro-batching to simulate load.
Sam: Good call. Also include cost estimate: 8xA100 @ provider spot/reserved differs. CloudProcurement, what's the immediate cost delta to do a 12hr soft-reserve vs a pay-as-you-go spike?
CloudProcurement: Rough numbers: pay-as-you-go ~ $35/hr per A100. Short-term soft-reserve (provider commit) could add a 10-15% uplift. I'll attach a quick calc here: `8 * 35 * 12 = $3360` baseline.
Maria: Ok. I'll submit the internal form now and paste the provider request email below for review.
Maria: ```
To: cloud-billing@provider.example
Subject: Quota reservation request — us-west3-a — 8xA100 — 2027-05-12 08:00-12:00 PST
Body:
Hello,
Requesting temporary reservation for 8 A100 GPUs in us-west3-a for staging soak and performance validation on 2027-05-12 08:00-12:00 PST. Project: Redwood-Staging-42. Contact: maria@redwood.example.
Please confirm hold and any steps to convert to a hard reservation.
Thanks,
Maria
```
Sam: LGTM. Add expected network egress estimate and a rollback contact (oncall: leo).
Maria: Done. Form submitted: https://internal.forms/gpu-quota/submit/2003 — got ticket #GQ-4821
Ops-Bot: Ops-Bot: Ticket GQ-4821 created. Workflow: cloudprocurement -> provider -> infra oncall -> final ack.
CloudProcurement: Submitted provider request at 2003458000. Waiting on provider ack. I'll post updates.
Leo: If provider denies soft hold, we'll trigger fallback: reduce to 4 GPUs + local micro-batch. Maria/Devon can you validate perf baseline for that config by noon?
Devon: Will run perf test by 11:30. If results within 12% error, we proceed with fallback.
Maria: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: once you've read. I'll keep the thread updated with provider responses.
CloudProcurement: Provider ack received at 2003458600 — soft hold granted pending PO. They need PO within 48h to convert. Marking here: provider ref PR-78921.
Sam: Great. Can procurement start PO paperwork? Nina, Procurement legal signoff required?
Nina: Legal thumbs-up for short-term PO. Send draft to legal@redwood.example and cc procurement.
Maria: Closing loop — schedule looks good. Will reopen thread if we need hard reservation. :white_check_mark:
